name: Quansheng ALERT receiver (UV-K5, archived)
tagline: The first ALERT receiver firmware, for the older DP32G030 Quansheng UV-K5 family. Archived; still builds and flashes.
about: Firmware for the UV-K5, UV-K5(8) and UV-K6 (DP32G030, bootloader 2.x), built on egzumer's firmware, that turns the handheld into an ALERT flood-telemetry receiver with a station table generated from Flood-Net. It was archived when work moved to the UV-K5 V3, but its builds and its own web installer still work, and in October 2026 it took the V3's on-air-proven demodulator and decoder. It needs a one-capacitor mod to hear the audio, and no modded radio has decoded on air yet.

status.summary: Archived and read-only; its last builds (20 October) carry the V3's decoder, but no modded UV-K5 has been tried on air yet.

blocked.what: First field test: a UV-K5 with the one-capacitor mod beside an ALERT transmitter

components.name: ALERT receiver app
components.what: Burst capture, screens, settings and voice read-out, and one ALERT line per reading on the programming cable's UART.

components.name: Software AFSK demodulator
components.what: Samples the receiver audio on PA8 (through the capacitor mod) at 9600 Hz and recovers the 300-baud bits; the V3's design.

components.name: Frame decoder
components.what: ABF, EIF and A2C decoding, identical to the V3's App/app/alert_decode.c.

components.name: Station table
components.what: About 6 KB of station names generated from Flood-Net by stations.filter, looked up by binary search in flash.

components.name: Fine squelch
components.what: A 0.0 to 9.0 squelch with open and close delays for the whole radio, so weak bursts open it quickly.

components.name: Web installer
components.what: Four-step Web Serial installer for the UV-K5, with backup and restore, a cable-building page and k5diag.py; still served.

components.name: Published firmware
components.what: Two builds (default: Mt Kanigan and neighbours; South-East Queensland) with a manifest naming the source and Flood-Net commits.

components.name: CI build
components.what: Built both variants weekly and committed the binaries; stopped when the repository was archived.

components.name: egzumer base firmware
components.what: egzumer's custom UV-K5 firmware (Apache-2.0), with some features switched off to make room for the station table.

provides.name: Published UV-K5 builds
provides.what: The final firmware images and manifest.json (size, sha256, station count, source and Flood-Net commits); quansheng_alert_ALL copies them.

provides.name: ALERT line on the programming cable
provides.what: ALERT,<id>,<value>,<ABF|EIF>,<rssi dBm>,<name> at 38400 8N1 for every reading; RPi ALERT's Quansheng driver reads it.

provides.name: UV-K5 installer and cable tools
provides.what: The Web Serial installer, the cable page and k5diag.py that quansheng_alert_ALL grew its two-family installer from.

consumes.what: Station names, sensor kinds, ALERT addresses and repeater networks for the built-in table.
consumes.on_change: Nothing can run while the repository is archived: its weekly build has stopped. To refresh, unarchive it and run build.yml, which regenerates the table and republishes both builds.

consumes.what: The ABF and EIF bit layouts and CRC-6, a straight port of packets.js.
The V3's on-air-proven demodulator and decoder, brought over in October 2026 (alert_decode.c verbatim).
consumes.on_change: Nothing while archived; a revived fork would copy alert_decode.c across again.
